novelty.mechanism_link: Conditional trajectory value of complete compensation-aware native channel actions. The quadratic identity, low-rank compensation and finite action routing are established ingredients.

nearest_prior_art.comparison: PulseQuant already joins video propagation profiling and response-subspace correction; candidate differs through input-conditioned physical FFN group computation.
FastForward combines predictive FFN sparsity and compensation; trajectory net-action value is the candidate distinction.
TCEC studies diffusion quantization propagation and compensation; trajectory compensation alone is not novel.
Conditional acquisition value is established decision theory; the native compensated action structure must carry the contribution.
